title: The Closest Pair
statementMd:
Currently Tiny is learning Computational Geometry. When trying to solve a problem called "The Closest Pair Of Points In The Plane", he found that a code which gave a wrong time complexity got Accepted instead of Time Limit Exceeded.

The problem is the follows. Given $*n*$ points in the plane, find a pair of points between which the distance is minimized. Distance between $(*x*_{1}, *y*_{1})$ and $(*x*_{2}, *y*_{2})$ is ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a0c6a684203590998776587e7f02c93ba5771038.png).

The pseudo code of the unexpected code is as follows:

```
input n
for i from 1 to n
    input the i-th point's coordinates into p[i]
sort array p[] by increasing of x coordinate first and increasing of y coordinate second
d=INF        //here INF is a number big enough
tot=0
for i from 1 to n
    for j from (i+1) to n
        ++tot
        if (p[j].x-p[i].x>=d) then break    //notice that "break" is only to be
                                            //out of the loop "for j"
        d=min(d,distance(p[i],p[j]))
output d
```

Here, $*tot*$ can be regarded as the running time of the code. Due to the fact that a computer can only run a limited number of operations per second, $*tot*$ should not be more than $*k*$ in order not to get Time Limit Exceeded.

You are a great hacker. Would you please help Tiny generate a test data and let the code get Time Limit Exceeded?

## Input

A single line which contains two space-separated integers $*n*$ and $*k*$ ($2 ≤ *n* ≤ 2000$, $1 ≤ *k* ≤ 10^{9}$).

## Output

If there doesn't exist such a data which let the given code get TLE, print "`no solution`" (without quotes); else print $*n*$ lines, and the $*i*$-th line contains two integers $*x*_{*i*}, *y*_{*i*}$ $(|*x*_{*i*}|, |*y*_{*i*}| ≤ 10^{9})$ representing the coordinates of the $*i*$-th point.

The conditions below must be held:

- All the points must be distinct.
- $|*x*_{*i*}|, |*y*_{*i*}| ≤ 10^{9}$.
- After running the given code, the value of $*tot*$ should be larger than $*k*$.
statementZhMd:
## 题目描述

目前 Tiny 正在学习计算几何。在尝试解决一道名为“平面上最近点对”的题目时，他发现一份时间复杂度错误的代码竟然获得了 Accepted，而不是 Time Limit Exceeded。

题目如下：给定平面上的 $*n*$ 个点，找出距离最小的一对点。点 $(*x*_{1}, *y*_{1})$ 与 $(*x*_{2}, *y*_{2})$ 之间的距离为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a0c6a684203590998776587e7f02c93ba5771038.png)。

这份意外通过的代码的伪代码如下：

```
input n
for i from 1 to n
    input the i-th point's coordinates into p[i]
sort array p[] by increasing of x coordinate first and increasing of y coordinate second
d=INF        //here INF is a number big enough
tot=0
for i from 1 to n
    for j from (i+1) to n
        ++tot
        if (p[j].x-p[i].x>=d) then break    //notice that "break" is only to be
                                            //out of the loop "for j"
        d=min(d,distance(p[i],p[j]))
output d
```

这里，$*tot*$ 可以视为该代码的运行时间。由于计算机每秒只能执行有限次操作，为了不超出时间限制，$*tot*$ 不应大于 $*k*$。

你是一名出色的黑客。请你帮助 Tiny 生成一组测试数据，使这份代码获得 Time Limit Exceeded。

## 输入格式

一行包含两个用空格分隔的整数 $*n*$ 和 $*k*$（$2 ≤ *n* ≤ 2000$，$1 ≤ *k* ≤ 10^{9}$）。

## 输出格式

如果不存在能使给定代码超时的数据，输出 `no solution`（不含引号）；否则输出 $*n*$ 行，其中第 $*i*$ 行包含两个整数 $*x*_{*i*}, *y*_{*i*}$（$|*x*_{*i*}|, |*y*_{*i*}| ≤ 10^{9}$），表示第 $*i*$ 个点的坐标。

必须满足以下条件：

- 所有点必须互不相同。
- $|*x*_{*i}|, |*y*_{*i}| ≤ 10^{9}$。
- 运行给定代码后，$*tot*$ 的值应大于 $*k*$。
